title: A refused background done or land counts its later prompts as the item's rework
goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-cwoyc7yh: a background done, land or merge always reports success at launch, so ql_capture never writes the refused row a foreground refusal writes (refused_done); once the landing is refused or stops, the prompts after it stay in the item's window (BG-cwoyc7yh) but no rework block is counted for them. A refused or stopped background landing is recorded as refused (from the task's completion as the session later sees it, or the land's own record of its stop), so backlog.py cost --rework counts those prompts as rework, and querylog.md, usage.md and backlog.md's Cost of work say how.

run: import os,sys,json,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;cmd='python3 _tools/backlog.py land ST-aaaaaaaa';q.capture({'hook_event_name':'UserPromptSubmit','session_id':'s1','prompt':'x','cwd':str(t)});q.capture({'hook_event_name':'PostToolUse','session_id':'s1','cwd':str(t),'tool_name':'Bash','tool_input':{'command':cmd,'run_in_background':True},'tool_response':{'stdout':'','stderr':'','backgroundTaskId':'b1'}});q.capture({'hook_event_name':'Stop','session_id':'s1','cwd':str(t),'background_tasks':[{'id':'b1','type':'shell','status':'failed','command':cmd}]});rows=[json.loads(l) for p in Path(q.spool_dir()).glob('*.jsonl') for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()];w=[(r.get('item'),r.get('action')) for r in rows if r.get('surface')=='work'];print('work rows after a background land the session sees fail:',w);sys.exit(0 if ('ST-aaaaaaaa','refused') in w else 1)
